content:
Update the requested_action  attribute for a scan. The requested action must be valid for the
scan's current status. For example, you can pause or stop a scan if it has a status of running  or
resume a scan if it has a status of paused . Otherwise, Tenable Web App Scanning returns a 409
response code. This request creates an asynchronous update job.
Requires the Scan Operator [24] user role or the WAS.SCAN_WAS.MANAGE  custom role privilege.
Additionally, requires the Can Execute [32] scan permission. See Roles and Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the scan for which you want to update status.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
required
string
Enum: "pause"
"resume"
"stop"
The action to apply to the scan.
